shot.name: boat-launch-v4
shot.sourceBrief: Create a memorable AutoPromote welcome film and social campaign from an idea alone, with no recorded footage. Show imagination becoming finished work, rather than a feature list.
shot.storyRole: opening: an ordinary recognisable paper boat physically gains a moving world
shot.prompt: The same one traditional ivory folded PAPER BOAT stays intact and completely visible. Its open diamond-shaped hull, pointed bow and stern, and two low central triangular folds retain their exact shape. Immediately, blue water seeps from beneath the blank sheet and flows rapidly across the wooden tabletop around the boat. Moving ripples lift the hull off the table so it visibly bobs and floats. The low camera smoothly pulls backward as the moving water expands into an immense blue ocean, while the wooden desk falls outside the frame. The boat remains small in the centre of the shot, fully visible, never turns into a bird or crane. Warm amber practical light on tactile paper, deep blue shadow, realistic reflective flowing water, physical buoyancy, cinematic 35mm lens. One continuous five-second impossible but photoreal shot. No cut, no text, no mast, no additional objects.
